rel_overlays.note: ALL OS/kernel code lives in the DOL; the overlays contain zero privileged instructions and zero translator gaps - their only blocker is indirect dispatch

remainder.note_unmapped: TEXT0 exception vectors - the host boundary by definition

__OSReschedule.evidence: body is lwz r0,RunQueueHint(r13); cmpwi 0; beq; li r3,0; bl 0x800ebd68 - matches ~/gc_refs/dolsdk2001/src/os/OSThread.c:395-399 exactly

SelectThread.evidence: sole caller of OSSaveContext (DOLSDK OSThread.c:357 is OSSaveContext's only call site) and calls 0x800e56bc at 0x800ebf48

OSLoadContext.evidence: immediately follows OSSaveContext, ends in rfi, called by SelectThread - DOLSDK OSContext.c:281 with its rfi at :350. IDENTIFICATION IS STRUCTURAL, NOT SIGNATURE-MATCHED.

host_os_boundary.conclusion: the SCHEDULER POLICY (SelectThread, __OSReschedule) is ordinary translatable code; only the setjmp/longjmp primitives OSSaveContext + OSLoadContext are the host boundary. Two functions, not a rewrite of the OS.

differential_regression.slice: 4 SAB leaf fns 0x800ed368 PSMTXConcat / 0x800ed484 PSMTXInverse / 0x800edab8 PSMTXMultVec / 0x800ede34 PSVECCrossProduct

NOT_measured: NO performance number of any kind for the SAB static-recomp path.
NO overlay (.rel) function has been differentially verified - all bit-exactness is DOL functions.

The new x-form update load/stores (lwzux/lbzux/lhzux/lhaux/stwux/stbux/sthux/lfsux/lfdux/stfsux/stfdux) are NOT differentially verified; the 1056-vector suite does not reach them. The wasm was byte-identical, so the edit is proven ADDITIVE, not proven CORRECT.
Indirect dispatch (blrl/bctr) is DESIGNED (N64Recomp LOOKUP_FUNC) but NOT BUILT here - P1 is a policy assumption, not a measurement.
The host context-switch implementation is not built; three known mechanisms exist (Asyncify, one host thread per guest thread, JSPI) and none is chosen or measured.
Executed-code coverage under a real SAB run was not measured. All numbers here are STATIC.
OSLoadContext / SelectThread identifications are structural (adjacency + rfi + call graph + DOLSDK source shape), not signature-matched against the SDK binary.
